review.notes: Scan PDF is local-first and fully usable as a guest. The library is empty on first launch. Tap the orange camera button to scan, or use Photos/Files import. Apple Vision performs document detection, QR decoding, and OCR on-device. Optional Sign in with Apple or passwordless email enables Supabase cloud backup, AI, priority support, and expense reports. AI actions always show a confirmation before OCR text or a captured image is sent to the configured backend AI processor. The OpenAI key is never in the app and backend requests set store=false. Plus is an auto-renewable monthly subscription using product plus_pdf_monthly: 3-day introductory trial, then $3.99/month. StoreKit supplies the localized live price. Purchase and Restore are on the paywall; Restore is also in Settings. Signed-in transactions are validated through the backend before Supabase entitlement state is updated. Receipt Rescue Challenge is free, requires no login or purchase, and opens with scanpdf://receipt-rescue. Its window is 2026-08-17 through 2026-09-17 23:59 and its local goal is 15 receipts. Game Center capability is enabled; this version has no leaderboard or achievement UI. Account deletion is in Account and removes cloud files plus the auth account; local documents remain under the user's local control until removed from the device.

en-US.description:
Turn your iPhone into a fast document scanner and practical PDF workbench. Capture paper, receipts, IDs, notes, books, and whiteboards; correct the perspective; clean the page; and save a sharp PDF in seconds.

SCAN AND ORGANIZE
Scan one page or a whole batch. Use automatic document capture or adjust the crop yourself, then rotate, reorder, add, delete, split, and filter pages. Import photos, images, and PDFs. Organize scans in folders and recover deleted work from Trash.

FIND TEXT INSIDE SCANS
On-device text recognition makes document titles, folder names, and recognized page text searchable. Copy recognized text or export TXT and Word files. Searchable PDF export can add a text layer while preserving the scanned page.

POWERFUL DOCUMENT TOOLS
Sign with a drawn, imported, or saved signature. Merge documents, extract selected pages, compress PDFs, add text or image watermarks, create password-protected PDF copies, print with AirPrint, and export PDF, JPG, PNG, TXT, Word, or PowerPoint.

SPECIAL CAMERA MODES
Use Document, Text, Book, QR Code, Translate, Measure, and Count modes. Book mode splits a photographed spread. QR decoding and OCR run on-device. Measure uses a known reference, and Count lets you correct the detected total before saving or sharing.

LOCAL-FIRST, CLOUD WHEN YOU CHOOSE
The core scanner works as a guest and keeps its library on-device. Optional Apple or passwordless-email sign-in enables private cloud backup and restore. Cloud upload is off until you enable it.

OPTIONAL AI TOOLS
With your confirmation, AI can answer questions about recognized document text, summarize it, extract structured fields, translate it, count visible objects, and prepare editable expense-report data. The app explains what will be processed before sending text or an image.

SCAN PDF PLUS
Plus includes advanced conversion, AI, workflows, reusable signatures, auto upload, book and translation tools, high-quality batch output, expense reports, and priority support. Start with a 3-day trial, then $3.99 per month. Cancel in App Store settings.

RECEIPT RESCUE CHALLENGE
During the limited-time event, preserve 15 fading thermal receipts as searchable PDFs and track progress locally. No login or purchase is required.

Privacy Policy: https://www.termsfeed.com/live/caab9580-c317-40c6-894d-2e98ce454f39
